installCommand: APP_DIR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/packages/app"; [ -d "$APP_DIR" ] || APP_DIR="$PWD"; cd "$APP_DIR" && pwd && npm install --no-workspaces
buildCommand: APP_DIR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/packages/app"; [ -d "$APP_DIR" ] || APP_DIR="$PWD"; cd "$APP_DIR" && pwd && npm run build
